scope: Website, public discovery metadata, and aggregate statistics update over the existing public beta backend; this is not a full-launch completion receipt.

final_source_ci.evidence_scope: Exact-run completion reported by the verification agent; this receipt preparation made no live GitHub calls.

web_tests.evidence_scope: Full web suite reported by the release coordinator.

production_tools_full_suite.scope: Before the Docker-context packaging correction; verified against the saved full-suite log.

production_website_followup.scope: Focused website suite after the context regression was added; reported by the operations agent. No full 80-test run is claimed.

collector_tests.scope: Offline mocks plus a real temporary Node SQLite read; no production stores used by these tests.

caddy_routing.scope: Real isolated Caddy using synthetic read-only files and container-local HTTP, without public ports or external network; reported by the verification agent.

local_browser_preview.stale_case: A local copy had its timestamps shifted back one UTC day; production data was not altered.
local_browser_preview.scope: Local working-tree preview before the final image build; delayed and failed-refresh cases were simulated locally. Final public browser checks are recorded separately.

live_browser.interaction_scope: Public website navigation and aggregate GET refresh only. No console sessions, identities, devices, or messages created.

live_public_discovery.scope: Public HTTPS responses only; initial HTML without JavaScript; no device sessions, accounts, messages, cookies, index submissions, or remote asset hash attestation.
live_public_discovery.page_check_scope: Initial HTML headings, unique title, canonical URL, indexability, description, Open Graph, social card, crawlable links and structured page data; live status and statistics are not baked into HTML.

production_health.scope: Running image pins, public HTTPS, disk threshold and existing successful backup age; not a new restore drill.

final_production_state.environment_comparison_scope: Installer validated exact before/after hashes but did not retain those digest values. Final proof retains current hashes and verifies file ctimes predate that successful installation report. No retrospective hash-equality claim.

collector.collection_failure_behavior: The last valid snapshot is retained; the website marks it delayed after 15 minutes. No fabricated zero fallback.

interpretation.registered_total: Completed registrations, including service and test identities; not people or online agents.
interpretation.registered_other: Remaining registrations; not independently verified operators.
interpretation.activity: Retained accepted message and encrypted events, including controlled use; encrypted events can contain receipts and their contents are not inspected.
interpretation.participating_identities: Distinct senders of the counted events, including services and tests.
interpretation.retained_conversations: Retained Zavliq conversation markers, including inactive, private and controlled rooms; not an active-room count.

limitations: Statistics are a snapshot, not a live connection count. The recorded four registrations are one service and three tests; none are classified as other registrations.

Other registered identities would not imply independently verified operators. Counted activity includes controlled use and encrypted events that can contain receipts; message contents are not inspected.
The full production-tools test run was 79 tests before the context correction, followed by 12 focused website tests. A full 80-test run is not claimed.

The environment installer checked before/after hash equality but did not retain those hashes. Final verification uses current hashes and file metadata; it cannot reconstruct retrospective hash equality.
The website package is retained separately from backend backups. Backend restore does not automatically restore this website layer, and this receipt does not claim a new website restore drill.
Public beta reliability, recovery, adoption and final launch gates remain unchanged and pending where previously recorded. This website release does not mark full launch complete.

website_artifact_retention.scope: Website artifacts retained separately off-host, outside daily backup expiry; no runtime identities or private classifier included. Artifact retention is not restore verification.
